 Nordson DAGE 4000 Bond Tester System
Location
1242
Contact
Ryan Anderson
Manual
The Nordson DAGE 4000 bond tester system can be configured to perform multiple bonding characterizations including pull and shear tests. Ball shear and die (< 6mm) shear are currently available. The tooltip can apply shear force with multiple load ranges (10kg/20kg/40kg/100kg) and 0.01% max load accuracy. Destructive (Applying an increasing load until breaking the bonding structure) or non-destructive (applying a constant load for a specific duration) modes are available.
